Each rhythm gets its own model, chosen automatically: linear regression, boosted trees, a small neural net, nearest neighbours and the recent median by time of day are each tried with several settings and scored, next to the app\'s default estimate, on how well they predicted your latest entries. Save one to have it estimate reminders, Today and the widget; once a time passes, Today re-estimates it from how late the model has been before. Everything runs on this phone.

Baby Buddy is a free, open-source web app for tracking a baby\'s feeds, sleep, diapers and growth. You host it yourself (on a home server, NAS or cloud machine), so your data stays with you.
This app is an unofficial phone companion for it: it connects to your Baby Buddy server and keeps everything there, so the whole family shares the same log.
Set up a server: Baby Buddy on GitHub →
